stops.summary: Miss Bly sails away from New York this morning aboard the Augusta Victoria to start her round-the-world trip.
stops.title: Sails From New York
stops.hint: Kid, she's steaming east across the pond — think England's south coast, get moving!

stops.name: Southampton

clue.citationMla: The new North-west. (Deer Lodge, MT) 29 Nov. 1889, p. 1. Retrieved from the Library of Congress, www.loc.gov/item/sn84038125/1889-11-29/ed-1/.
clue.excerpt:
"NELLIE BLY'S" ROUTE.
Nov. 22. Leave Victoria station, London, 8 p. m., on India mail.
Nov. 23. Calais, Paris and Turin.
Nov. 24. Brindisi at 10:14 p. m.
Nov. 25. Leave Brindisi, steamship Cathay, 2 a. m.
Nov. 27. Ismailia
Dec. 3. Aden.
Dec. 10. Colombo (Ceylon).
Dec. 16. Penang.
Dec. 18. Singapore.

stops.summary: She is due in Southampton and rides by rail to London in three hours.
stops.title: Due in Southampton
stops.hint: Listen, kid, she hops rails to London then dashes across to France — follow south.

stops.name: Amiens

clue.citationMla: Daily Independent. (Elko, NV) 26 Nov. 1889, p. 3. Retrieved from the Library of Congress, www.loc.gov/item/sn84020355/1889-11-26/ed-1/.
clue.excerpt: The enterprising Nellie Bly is making good progress in her trip around the world, having arrived at Amiens, France, last Saturday where she met Jules Verne, the celebrated novelist. Miss Bisland will not be heard from for some time, as she is now crossing the Pacific on board the Oceanic.

stops.summary: She arrives in Amiens and meets celebrated novelist Jules Verne while making good progress.
stops.title: Meets Verne in Amiens
stops.hint: Good work, kid. She's eastbound — follow the rails south toward the Mediterranean steamer and keep her moving.
